name: Brumbaugh's Fruit Farm
description: Brumbaugh's Fruit Farm is an agritourism farm in 6420 Hollansburg-Arcanum Road, OH, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
